result.title: PnP*: A certifiable solver for Perspective-n-Point
result.summary: Estimating a camera pose from 3D-2D correspondences - Perspective-n-Point - is one of the most fundamental problems in computer vision. Existing methods either solve a minimal problem or replace the objective with an easier one. Surprisingly, no scalable certifiable solver for the actual Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE) exists. We propose PnP*, the first practical solver that guarantees efficient computation and returns a certifiable globally optimal solution. We prove that the underlying convex relaxation is exact under moderate noise, which to our knowledge is the first stability guarantee for any relaxation for the MLE of PnP. Furthermore, we reduce the relaxation by exploiting chordal sparsity pattern and quotient ring reduction such that the relaxation is tractable and scalable. The stability and scalability results are verified numerically, as PnP* returns a provably correct camera pose at over 10 Hz.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 PnP*，首个可扩展到实际规模且返回可认证全局最优解的 PnP 求解器：证明其凸松弛在中等噪声下精确，并借助弦稀疏结构与商环约简使松弛可解，实测能以 10 Hz 以上给出可证明正确的相机位姿。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「可认证最优性 + 噪声下稳定性保证」可能为检验 VLM 几何推理的 latent 状态是否与视觉证据自洽提供评价思路，结构化稀疏约简也可供核查状态表示的压缩方式。
